articles.title: Underdog CEO predicts Kalshi’s market share will fall to 50%
articles.summary: Kalshi's dominance in sports betting prediction markets is about to get a reality check, according to some upstart CEO convinced he can muscle in on the turf. If he's right that the market leader's share drops to 50%, it reshuffles a space that's been surprisingly concentrated and probably signals better odds and features are finally coming for bettors who got bored waiting.

articles.title: Opinion | Kalshi’s sports bets are everywhere. They’re also illegal.
articles.summary: Kalshi, the prediction markets platform, is getting slapped with legal pushback over sports betting offerings that regulators say violate federal law. If the feds actually enforce this, it could crater the entire regulatory gray zone that lets prediction markets operate in the US.

articles.title: Is Tickmill Launching Prediction Markets?
articles.summary: Tickmill, a forex and CFD broker, is apparently exploring entry into prediction markets, potentially expanding beyond traditional derivatives trading. If they actually launch, it's another data point showing institutional money is finally taking PM liquidity seriously instead of treating it like a Vegas sideshow.

articles.title: Kalshi stops operations in Utah after facing charges
articles.summary: Kalshi, one of the few legal prediction market platforms in the US, pulled out of Utah after facing unspecified charges that forced their hand. When regulators start picking off states one-by-one, it signals the entire industry might be playing legal whack-a-mole while Congress figures out what to do.

articles.title: Where Every League Stands on Kalshi, Polymarket
articles.summary: Sports leagues are finally taking public stances on whether they'll allow Kalshi and Polymarket to operate prediction markets on their games. If major leagues crack down, it chops off a significant revenue stream and user base for platforms that have built their entire pitch around real-money sports betting.

articles.title: Young New Yorkers are losing money on prediction markets. That's not a reason to ban them.
articles.summary: Young New Yorkers are dumping money into prediction markets and predictably getting wrecked, sparking the usual regulatory hand-wringing from people who think banning things solves problems. The real story is whether regulators actually listen to the "let people lose their own money" argument, or if we're headed for another round of restrictions that'll just push the action offshore.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI is now expected to go public sometime later in 2027 instead of earlier in the year, according to prediction market data. If true, it delays when early bettors can cash out their positions and shifts the timeline for one of tech's most anticipated IPOs by several months.

articles.title: Gold drops below $3,500; prediction markets price moderate year-end targets
articles.summary: Gold just punched below $3,500, and the market's not convinced it's heading back up before the ball drops. That matters because year-end gold targets are getting repriced lower, which means anyone holding bullish positions or betting on inflation hedges is about to get rekt.

articles.title: Kalshi NFL Market for Every Thanksgiving Game: Bills vs. Chiefs Should Be Tight
articles.summary: Kalshi just launched prediction markets for every Thanksgiving NFL game, giving bettors granular odds on individual matchups instead of the typical sportsbook monopoly. Bills-Chiefs being tight means sharp money will compress those odds fast, making the opening prices the only real edge before the market efficiently prices in all available information.

articles.title: Van Hollen Calls Senate Democratic Leader Race 'Wide Open' as Prediction Markets Favor Schumer
articles.summary: Senate Democrats are picking their next leader, and Van Hollen says it's anyone's game despite prediction markets heavily favoring Schumer to keep the role. The gap between political rhetoric and market odds creates an arbitrage opportunity if Van Hollen knows something the smart money doesn't.

articles.title: Los Angeles Lakers Announce Partnership with Kalshi
articles.summary: The Lakers are partnering with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, marking a major sports team's official embrace of event contracts. This legitimizes prediction markets as a mainstream sports engagement tool and signals that regulated prediction betting is becoming the norm rather than the exception in professional sports.

articles.title: Simon Denny on Prediction Markets, Speculation, and the Future of Truth
articles.summary: Simon Denny is making a case that prediction markets aren't just gambling tools, they're infrastructure for how we establish what's actually true in a world drowning in noise and incentive misalignment. If he's right, that reframes the entire industry from "betting app" to "epistemic utility," which changes how regulators, institutions, and smart money should be thinking about market design and participation.
